name: io.github.idoo/app-store-connect-mcp
title: App Store Connect MCP
description: MCP server for App Store Connect: releases, TestFlight, reviews, reports. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect API key ID

environmentVariables.name: ASC_ISSUER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Issuer ID (omit for an Individual API key)

environmentVariables.name: ASC_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Contents of the .p8 key (PEM or base64 PEM)

environmentVariables.name: ASC_VENDOR_NUMBER
environmentVariables.description: Vendor number for sales and finance reports

environmentVariables.name: ASC_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose write and destructive tools
